text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) had 
finally arrived. With her parents 
watching, Eishin Flash asked her Trainer 
to watch from the stands as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the thunderous cheers, Eishin 
Flash looks back on everything up to now. 
The awakening of "correctness," and along 
the path traveled in pursuit of it—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through countless experiences and 
connections, she found her own "truth" and 
quietly burned with the desire to prove it 
to the three of them.
